title: NetworkDockState
description: network.dock-state@1 (the Dock plan 2026-10-30, K-D1): the state of one person's Dock — the little floating surface every OpenVibe site draws. It lives in the Network, not in the browser, because localStorage is per site and the Dock follows the person across every domain. GET /api/v1/me/dock and PUT /api/v1/me/dock on OpenVibe.Network.

open.description: Whether the Dock is open (a sheet on a phone, a floating card on a desktop) or collapsed to its pill.

tab.description: Which of the Dock's tabs shows: Vibe (the person's AI, plan L48 V2), the agents, the chats, the activity.

pinned.description: Keep the pill on screen even when nothing runs and nothing waits.

agent.description: The agent the Agent tab follows, or null when it follows none.

chat.description: The conversation the Chats tab has open, or null.

timer.description: The person's timer (plan L48 R2): it counts down in the Dock's pill on every site and rings at its end. Absent or null: none. A focus timer of rounds alternates focus and break by itself.

kind.description: A plain timer, a focus block, or the break after one.

label.description: What it is for, in the person's words.

rounds.description: How many focus rounds in all.

focus_min.description: A focus round's length, in minutes.

phone.description: Where the Dock sits on a phone.

desktop.description: Where the Dock sits on a desktop, and how big it is (null: the site's own default size).

updated_at.description: When the state was last written.
